Company: Acme Cloud
Title: Senior Backend Engineer
Location: Remote - United States

We are seeking a senior backend engineer with 7+ years of experience building distributed
systems. The engineer will design Python and Golang microservices, operate Kubernetes workloads
on AWS, build Kafka event pipelines, and expose gRPC and REST APIs. Experience with PostgreSQL,
Docker, and Terraform is required. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States;
we are unable to sponsor visas for this role.

Preferred qualifications:
Experience with Redis, LangGraph, Agentic AI, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
